user.title: Add your amplifier
user.description: An amplifier set up under the Monoprice integration was found. Import it to keep its zones, tone controls, names, areas and history. The amplifier is unavailable for a moment while it moves.

menu_options.manual: Set up an amplifier by address

manual.title: Connect your amplifier
manual.description: Enter its serial device or serial-over-IP address. Do not add an amplifier that another integration already controls on the same port.

error.unknown: Connection failed. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: An amplifier on this connection is already set up in No Hassle AV Amplifier.
abort.legacy_not_found: No amplifier from the Monoprice integration was found to import.

snapshot.name: Save amplifier state
snapshot.description: Save the selected amplifier zone state for later restoration.

restore.name: Restore amplifier state
restore.description: Restore the selected amplifier zone snapshot.
